caption: Figure 7: (a) provides an overview of MegaStation. (b)/(c) depict the details of the instruction unit and scoreboarding.

templates.why_chosen: Panel (b) traces read-after-write dependencies with curved orange lines from an instruction stream into a small branching DAG of latency-annotated nodes, one of three dense panels at 22 components total.
templates.what_to_learn: Build the DAG panel directly from a labelled instruction stream by drawing curved dependency lines from each entry to its node, in a colour distinct from the architecture diagram's plain arrows, and pair it with a schema panel of the tables that track per-node state; keep node labels specific, not generic.

templates.why_chosen: Panel (a)'s labeled architecture (Instruction Unit, Pipeline Schedulers, Scoreboarding over a GPU pool) is followed by two independent zooms, an instruction-to-DAG translation and a three-table scoreboard schema, the archetypal overview-plus-unlike-details split.
templates.what_to_learn: Let one architecture panel own the palette (gray boundaries, busy-slot shading) and name every subsystem directly on it, then let each detail panel use its own visual language, a dependency DAG with curved orange edges, a table with bracketed column groups in dark-red italics; keep font size well above this figure's dense, small-print floor.
